Vyvanse
My girlfriend has a prescription for the drug Vyvanse, and I've taken it at least 20 or 30 times, so I have some experience with it.
I've found personally that a dose of 50 mg feels similar to around 25-30 mg of Adderall. The effects of Vyvanse are very similar, especially the first few times, but Vyvanse seems to me to have an unpleasant body high on the comedown. Several friends also agree with me that it feels significantly less social than Adderall. Overall, I'd say it's a dirty chemical. I don't much like it at all, but used every now and again, it can really help with tests and that kind of thing that amphetamines help with.
PS - I'm kinda baked so sorry if this didn't all make sense.
I wrote this report because Vyvanse is increasing in recreational use in my area significantly.
